description: NEOARM column positions read by hand off the JEOL cross-section diagram (neoarm_column_diagram.png), metres below the specimen (negative = above). Scale: the 20 cm elliptical box on the left of the diagram spans 96 px, so 1 px = 2.08 mm. Read once by eye: each value is good to a few pixels (about 5 mm), and the whole column scales with that one 20 cm assumption.
source: examples/microscope_models/measure_microscope_geometry.ipynb, git 126961f (2026-06-12); the raw diagram file microscope.png was never committed. An earlier reading in projector_model_tem.ipynb (git 0b3a210) put IL1 at 684 px (0.227 m), CL1 at 340 px and CL2 at 360 px.
